mapper.insert: INSERT INTO storybooks ( plan_id, member_id, title, content, thumbnail_path, is_public ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{thumbnailPath}, #{isPublic} )
mapper.update: UPDATE storybooks SET title = #{request.title}, content = #{request.content}, thumbnail_path = #{request.thumbnailPath}, is_public = #{request.isPublic} WHERE id = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM storybooks WHERE id = #{storyId}

SELECT s.id AS storyId, s.plan_id AS planId, s.title, s.content, s.member_id AS memberId, COALESCE(m.name, '알 수 없음') AS writerName, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdDate, s.thumbnail_path AS thumbnailPath, s.is_public AS isPublic, s.hit FROM storybooks s LEFT JOIN members m ON s.member_id = m.id WHERE s.id = #{storyId}

SELECT p.id as plan_id, p.title as plan_title, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.description as plan_description, pd.plan_date, pd.sequence, a.id as attraction_id, a.title as attraction_title, a.content_type_id, a.addr1 FROM plans p LEFT JOIN plan_details pd ON p.id = pd.plan_id LEFT JOIN attractions a ON pd.attraction_id = a.id WHERE p.id = #{planId} ORDER BY pd.plan_date, pd.sequence;
